queries.command: fak capabilities "bounded concurrent coding agent fleet"
queries.result: Returned general fleet-commit-health and capability-floor cards, not an effective per-child Ultracode activation receipt.

fak_witness.result: The profile resolves and plans, but the latest live status cannot prove that each child accepted the posture.

mechanisms.decision: Keep typed activation as a default and require explicit accepted/unknown/degraded child state before causal value claims.

queries.command: fak-dev feature query "ultracode plan graph roles leases witness reconcile" --limit 3
queries.result: Returned the Ultracode dogfood and orchestration surfaces.

fak_witness.result: A canonical role/edge/budget/lease/witness/reconcile plan is already shipped.

mechanisms.decision: Retain fak's typed graph; borrow declarative examples as fixtures, not as a second planner.

mechanisms.axis: bounded child input and returned context

queries.command: fak-dev feature query "ultracode child context per graph node" --limit 3
queries.result: Located the plan/profile documentation and the explicit per-node child-context owner.

fak_witness.result: Role inputs are typed, but per-node child context and returned context are not yet exposed end to end.

mechanisms.decision: Default to minimal role-specific context and measure accepted output per admitted context token.

queries.command: fak capabilities "bounded concurrent coding agent fleet"
queries.result: Found fleet health/capability cards; the live Ultracode run had three exited workers and no verified completed turn.

seams: fak ultracode status --json => 3 exited, outcome unverified
fak_witness.result: Admission and concurrency limits exist; accepted parallel outcome remains an adapter/live-run gap.

mechanisms.decision: Keep bounded concurrency behind capability negotiation; do not equate spawned workers with completed work.

mechanisms.axis: typed parent-child and peer message exchange

queries.result: Returned no direct capability card although internal/a2achan provides a typed capability-floored bus; this is a lexical discovery miss.

fak_witness.result: A message bus and interaction policy exist, but adapter delivery/readback is not witnessed for the current Ultracode run.

owner.scope: Codex worker message delivery and readback

mechanisms.decision: Use typed messages for progress and coordination, durable artifacts for critical outputs, and delivery/readback as the oracle.

queries.command: fak-dev feature query "ultracode lease effect successor ownership" --limit 3
queries.result: Located the orchestration lease policy and effect-successor identity contract.

fak_witness.result: Lease identity and effect-successor checks exist; graph-node status/readback remains incomplete.

mechanisms.decision: Keep exact-tree/effect leases as fak's stronger default; A2A task authorization and LangGraph checkpoint identity are not lease substitutes.

queries.command: fak-dev feature query "task progress witness graph node" --limit 3
queries.result: Located task-manager progress and per-node status work.

fak_witness.result: Structured task progress exists, while the latest Ultracode run exposes process exit rather than accepted graph-node completion.

mechanisms.decision: Report node progress and terminal state separately from process liveness; current snapshot precedes stream recovery.

queries.command: fak-dev feature query "ultracode cancellation orphan cleanup" --limit 3
queries.result: Located task cancellation plus adapter-specific owners #5970 and #5973.

fak_witness.result: Task cancellation is shipped; adapter process cleanup and post-cancel readback are not fully witnessed.

owner.scope: Claude adapter cancellation and orphan cleanup

mechanisms.decision: Cancellation stays best-effort until terminal state and cleanup are read back; never imply compensation of completed effects.

queries.command: fak-dev feature query "effect successor receipt witness" --limit 3
queries.result: Located the effect-successor receipt schema and per-node exposure owner.

fak_witness.result: The receipt contract binds snapshot epoch and lease identity, but live graph-node readback is not yet complete.

mechanisms.decision: Retain fak's effect-specific readback; self-authored checkpoint writes or artifacts alone do not prove an external effect.

queries.result: General capability search missed the workflow witness leaf; feature query found the shipped generic resume and Ultracode witness contracts.

fak_witness.result: Witness records and plan requirements exist; the latest live Ultracode run reports independent witness not observed.

mechanisms.decision: Independent witness remains a default completion gate; Claude reviewer redundancy, LangGraph pending writes, and A2A artifacts are inputs, not proof by themselves.

mechanisms.axis: controller restart and witness-keyed selective resume

queries.command: fak-dev feature query "witnessed workflow resume recovery" --limit 3
queries.result: Found shipped generic workflow journal/resume (#2444) but no Ultracode graph-to-journal launch integration.

fak_witness.result: Generic witness-keyed resume is shipped; Ultracode does not persist its graph/launch receipts into that journal.

mechanisms.decision: Connect the existing seams; skip an effect only after independent corroboration and re-lease every incomplete effect node.

mechanisms.axis: accepted outcome, speed, token, cache, and quality attribution

queries.command: fak capabilities "accepted outcome token cache quality benchmark"
queries.result: Returned context-reuse and savings cards; internal/ultracodebench supplies the paired GAIN/NO_GAIN/ABSTAIN schema but its selfcheck is offline.

seams: fak ultracode bench --selfcheck => offline fixture GAIN
fak_witness.result: The measurement schema is shipped; live paired accepted-outcome evidence remains open and effective activation is not yet joinable.

mechanisms.decision: Keep a paired, accepted-outcome benchmark with activation coverage; #8337 owns role frontier and #8404 owns cross-harness trajectory attribution.

benchmarks.treatment: Ultracode requested and explicitly acknowledged active by every admitted child
benchmarks.control: same harness/workload with Ultracode explicitly off
benchmarks.workload: matched small repository task with identical model, budget, tools, and starting revision
benchmarks.quality_oracle: same independently witnessed accepted outcome; unknown activation abstains

denominators.cache: accepted reused input tokens per eligible repeated input token

benchmarks.falsification_condition: Any treatment child lacks explicit activation readback, or outcome quality/regression fails the oracle.

benchmarks.treatment: typed graph with declared roles, edges, budgets, leases, witness, and reconcile policy
benchmarks.control: single unstructured coordinator prompt over the same task
benchmarks.workload: same bounded multi-file task and source revision
benchmarks.quality_oracle: accepted diff covers all graph obligations with no duplicate ownership

denominators.token: accepted graph obligations per billed token
denominators.cache: reused stable-plan tokens per eligible stable-plan token

benchmarks.falsification_condition: Graph arm adds coordination cost without improving accepted coverage or collision rate.

benchmarks.treatment: role-minimal declared child context with curated result return
benchmarks.control: full parent transcript copied to each child
benchmarks.workload: same two-role repository investigation and implementation task
benchmarks.quality_oracle: same independently accepted findings and implementation witness

denominators.token: accepted child outputs per admitted context token
denominators.cache: reused resident child-prefix tokens per eligible child-prefix token

benchmarks.falsification_condition: Minimal context drops an acceptance-critical fact or costs more accepted-output tokens.

benchmarks.treatment: bounded admitted parallel children on disjoint trees
benchmarks.workload: three independent read/implementation packets with fixed budgets
benchmarks.quality_oracle: same accepted artifacts and witnesses with zero path collisions

denominators.cache: reused shared-prefix tokens per eligible shared-prefix token

benchmarks.falsification_condition: Parallelism increases collision, duplicate work, or total accepted-work latency.

benchmarks.treatment: typed bounded messages plus durable critical artifacts
benchmarks.workload: same dependency handoff with one mid-run correction
benchmarks.quality_oracle: delivery/readback and final artifact agree on dependency state

denominators.cache: reused message-schema tokens per eligible schema token

benchmarks.falsification_condition: A critical output exists only in an unrecoverable message or typed messaging adds more correction work.

benchmarks.treatment: exact-tree and effect lease admission with expiry/readback
benchmarks.workload: same overlapping candidate packets including one intentional collision
benchmarks.quality_oracle: one owner per effect/tree and no unleased mutation lands

denominators.cache: reused lease-contract tokens per eligible contract token

benchmarks.falsification_condition: Lease arm admits duplicate ownership, blocks disjoint work, or leaves a stale effect unaccounted.

benchmarks.treatment: typed node progress plus current snapshot on reconnect
benchmarks.control: process liveness and free-form logs only
benchmarks.workload: same multi-node run with one disconnect/reconnect
benchmarks.quality_oracle: reported node states rederive from task/effect evidence

denominators.cache: reused state-schema tokens per eligible schema token

benchmarks.falsification_condition: A process exit is reported as accepted completion or reconnect loses terminal state.

benchmarks.treatment: typed cancel followed by terminal snapshot and orphan readback
benchmarks.control: terminate controller without task/child cleanup protocol
benchmarks.workload: same three-child run canceled during one effectful node
benchmarks.quality_oracle: all child/task states accounted; completed effects are not described as reversed

denominators.cache: reused cancel-schema tokens per eligible schema token

benchmarks.falsification_condition: Any orphan persists, terminal state is unknown, or cancellation claims compensation without readback.

benchmarks.treatment: effect successor receipt bound to epoch, lease, and state readback
benchmarks.control: worker self-report or artifact existence alone
benchmarks.workload: same effectful fixture with one stale lease and one forged self-report
benchmarks.quality_oracle: only the correct successor state is accepted

denominators.cache: reused receipt-schema tokens per eligible schema token

benchmarks.falsification_condition: A stale/forged receipt passes or the treatment repeats a corroborated effect.

benchmarks.control: worker declares completion without independent readback
benchmarks.workload: same task with one plausible false done claim
benchmarks.quality_oracle: witness matches committed paths, tests, and effect state

denominators.cache: reused witness-contract tokens per eligible contract token

benchmarks.falsification_condition: False done is accepted or witness cost outweighs avoided rework at equal quality.

benchmarks.treatment: restart from journal, skip corroborated effects, and re-lease incomplete nodes
benchmarks.control: restart the same Ultracode plan from its initial node
benchmarks.workload: fixed graph crashed after one corroborated effect and one uncorroborated launch
benchmarks.quality_oracle: same final accepted graph with zero repeated corroborated effects

denominators.speed: accepted recovered nodes per recovery wall-second
denominators.token: accepted recovered nodes per post-restart token
denominators.cache: reused journal-bound context tokens per eligible pre-crash token

benchmarks.falsification_condition: Resume repeats a corroborated effect, skips an uncorroborated effect, or crosses graph epoch.

benchmarks.treatment: live acknowledged Ultracode run with joined outcome, usage, cache, and trajectory evidence
benchmarks.workload: same model/provider/repository/task/start revision and fixed budget
benchmarks.quality_oracle: independently accepted outcome and no quality regression

denominators.token: accepted outcomes per billed input plus output token
denominators.cache: accepted cache-read tokens per provider-eligible repeated input token

benchmarks.falsification_condition: Activation is unknown, outcomes differ, denominators are missing, or treatment fails to beat the control on its declared claim.

uncovered_gaps.done: Persist Ultracode graph/receipt identities into the existing workflow journal; after a simulated controller crash, skip only independently corroborated effects and re-lease/rerun incomplete nodes with deterministic redacted JSON.
